name: UvSetup
description: Install uv (cross-platform) and add it to the PATH
helpMarkDown: Install uv (cross-platform) and add it to the PATH
author: Henry Daniel Mosquera

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: uv version
inputs.helpMarkDown: `latest` or an exact version such as `0.8.0`. Pin it for reproducible builds.

inputs.name: downloadBaseUrl
inputs.label: Download base URL (mirror)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Mirror of https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases for agents without internet access.

inputs.name: verifyChecksum
inputs.label: Verify checksum
inputs.helpMarkDown: Verify the published sha256 of the downloaded binary.

inputs.name: addToPath
inputs.label: Add uv to PATH
inputs.helpMarkDown: Make `uv` available to the following steps of the job.

outputVariables.name: uvPath
outputVariables.description: Absolute path of the uv executable

outputVariables.name: uvCacheHit
outputVariables.description: true when uv came from the agent tool cache
